Chapter 950: Chapter 13: Covert Cultivation on the Chaos Continent (Please Subscribe)

In the emptiness, amidst the chaos, a figure emerged and descended.

“I’ve arrived.” Lin Yuan carefully observed the vast continent floating in the distance, its size tens of times that of his home universe. An infinite aura radiated from the continent, spreading in all directions into the far reaches of the Chaos Void.

“The Ancient Ming Chaos Continent?” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

This continent was the Chaos Continent closest to his home universe. A hundred years had passed in the universe, but only four months in the Chaos Void.

Three months ago, as Lin Yuan roamed aimlessly through the Chaos Void, he inadvertently discovered the aura emanating from the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

After three months of travel, Lin Yuan finally arrived.

The closer he got to the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, the more frequently Lin Yuan encountered other powerful beings, and through interactions with these beings, he gained intelligence about the continent.

Information left by the peak master of the realm, ‘Cang Weiyang,’ also included an introduction to the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

“Not bad luck.” Lin Yuan felt pleased. The Ancient Ming Chaos Continent was on the edge of the map given by the predecessor ‘Cang Weiyang.’

A little further, and it would have been beyond the recorded range of the map.

The Chaos Void was boundless. Even the Chaos Great Saints could not reach its edge, let alone those in the master realm.

“Now, from my home universe…”

Lin Yuan glanced backwards.

With his current understanding of time and space, each breath could take him beyond the range of a home universe. Even so, he had been on the move tirelessly for more than three months.

One could imagine just how far the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent was from his home universe.

Of course, the word “far” here is only relative to Lin Yuan. For those in the master realm, it might take just a few hours to cross, and for those in the Chaos Realm, a mere thought would suffice.

The three tiers of the twelfth order – Path Splitting, Master, and Chaos – each tier was like an insurmountable gulf. It is said that surpassing the Chaos Realm would bring one close to becoming a Perfect Time Being, possessing some of the characteristics of Perfect Time Beings.

“The connection between my true body’s Primordial Spirit and my avatar is reaching its limit,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In the home universe, the ultimate doors of the Sixth Realm of time and space insight allow avatars to linger near the universe, but not for long, as they will be eroded and collapse under the influence of Chaos Qi.

Lin Yuan’s perception had reached the Seventh Realm, extending his avatar’s connection range far beyond that of the Sixth Realm, but even so, there was a limit.

But Lin Yuan was in luck. Before reaching the limit, he discovered the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, or rather, the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent happened to be within the range where his true body’s Primordial Spirit could maintain contact with the avatar.

“The ruler of the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent…”

Information about the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent flashed through Lin Yuan’s mind.

To be eligible to be called a Chaos Continent, one must certainly be backed by a Chaos Venerable.

And behind the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, the Chaos Venerable was none other than Ancient Ming, with the entire continent named after him.

The Ancient Ming Venerable valued fairness greatly. The Ancient Ming Chaos Continent he founded was bustling with trade, attracting powerful beings from nearby Chaos Void and even other Chaos Continents to come and trade.

“During the lifetime of the predecessor ‘Cang Weiyang,’ the Ancient Ming Venerable was already a renowned Chaos Venerable. Now, several Cosmic Eras have passed since the predecessor’s death, and the Ancient Ming Venerable is still here…” Lin Yuan felt quite emotional.

Normally, it is very, very difficult for a Chaos Venerable to die.

The Moyu Tower Master and Xuanhuang disappeared mysteriously, and it’s not certain whether they are dead.

And even if they are dead, it’s not necessarily due to being killed.

“Let’s go inside.”

Lin Yuan continued to approach the vast Chaos Continent in the distance.

The Ancient Ming Chaos Continent was covered by a grand formation, with thirty-three entrances and exits around. The entrance that Lin Yuan chose was the nearest one.

“To enter the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, you need to pay ten Chaos Stones,” a mental fluctuation transmitted to Lin Yuan’s ear at the entrance.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The Ancient Ming Chaos Continent prohibited fighting, making it incredibly safe.

Since it’s safe, naturally, there’s a fee to pay. Compared to the perilous Chaos Void, the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent at least offered order and safety.

Rustling.

Lin Yuan took out ten Chaos Stones. He had obtained quite a few Chaos Stones from the cave dwelling of the peak master of the realm ‘Cang Weiyang,’ though most were sent back to his home universe.

But the avatar still carried some, precisely for the scene in front of him.

With the information left by the predecessor ‘Cang Weiyang,’ Lin Yuan was very clear about many of the rules in the Chaos Void.

“Hmm?”

At that moment, Lin Yuan looked up to see several figures descending.

These figures, likely from the same tribe, paused at the entrance. Finally, they took out several twelve-order weapons to meet the ‘fee’ for entering the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent.

To enter the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, one must pay ten Chaos Stones, or equivalent treasures could be used to offset the cost.

However, most powerful beings would choose Chaos Stones. Using other treasures? They would pay a premium, as the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent would calculate it at the lowest price.

“Those few powerful beings must be twelfth-order Path Splitting realm beings who have just stepped out of a universe,” Lin Yuan speculated internally.

The Chaos Void fostered countless universes, every moment bringing the annihilation of universes and tiding over of twelfth-order Path Splitting realm beings through the cataclysmic tribulation.

For the twelfth-order Path Splitting realm beings within the universe, surviving the cataclysmic tribulation meant officially stepping into the Chaos Void. With good luck, they might find the nearest Chaos Continent to settle down on.

Bad luck? Drifting long in the Chaos Void might lead to various dangers and death.
